description: Phase 0 baseline for Wave AI (AI.0). All metric fields start as null/TODO and must be populated from the Cloudflare AI Gateway + LLM_COSTS Analytics Engine dashboards before AI.1 ships, so later items have a measurable before/after. Refreshed at the close of every Wave-AI phase.

daily_usd_by_route_model._todo: Query LLM_COSTS: SELECT route, model, SUM(cost_usd)/30 FROM llm_costs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY route, model ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 5

hit_ratio_by_route._todo: Pull from AI Gateway dashboard → andernet-ai (prod) → Analytics → Cached %.
hit_ratio_by_route._note: Expected 0 for every route at baseline because AI.1 (cf-aig-cache-ttl) has not shipped yet.

latency_ms._todo: Query WORKER_TAIL: SELECT route, quantileExact(0.5)(duration_ms), quantileExact(0.95)(duration_ms), quantileExact(0.99)(duration_ms) FROM worker_tail WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND route IN (...) GROUP BY route

workers_ai._todo: Pull from Cloudflare Workers AI dashboard → Usage → daily neurons.

error_rate._todo: Query LLM_COSTS: rows with retry_outcome='5xx' AND final response_status>=500 / total rows, last 30d.

refresh_log.note: Initial scaffold; metric fields TODO. Populate before AI.1 ships.

cf-aig-cache-ttl shipped on /api/llm (24h), /api/admin/coverage-priority (6h), /api/admin/analytics/insights (6h). gateway_cache.hit_ratio_by_route should populate after the 7-day observation window. Other admin LLM endpoints flagged for follow-on.
